description: Destroy a runtime: unregister its bus functions, kill it and free its slot. Pass exactly one of runtime_id (from a keep: true run) or namespace (a register_function namespace, e.g. "app" for app::greet).

request_schema.title: TeardownRequest
request_schema.description: Exactly one of `runtime_id` or `namespace` must be set.

namespace.description: Set when addressed by `namespace` — echoed in its canonical `app::` form, since more than one runtime (one per language) can back it and there is no single `runtime_id` to report.

runtime_id.description: Set when this teardown was addressed by `runtime_id`.

unregistered.description: Bus function ids this teardown unregistered, across every runtime it destroyed.
